phases.name: One Knee
phases.say: (Stone grinds on stone. It drops to one knee and lifts its head.)

phases.name: Crumbling
phases.say: (Cracks run up its body. It moves faster, as if it knows.)

say.open: (The Colossus turns its head toward the light of your torches.)
say.death: (It comes apart, and the hall is quiet.)

bestiary.lore: The workshop's last guardian, as tall as the hall, walking on the oldest orders it has.
bestiary.weakness: Water rusts it. Break the core while it charges Earthquake; break a fist and it drops to one knee, its Head open to aimed blows.
bestiary.pattern: Its fists slam four rows in turn. Every fourth turn, while both fists live, the core charges Earthquake on everyone for three turns: break the core or interrupt it. With a fist gone it kneels, slows, and its Head takes aimed blows at ×1.5; at a quarter it crumbles and speeds up.
